steps.name: deploy-curve
requiresPreviousStep: Finalized real minter transaction #1; never repeat it.
acceptance: Exact finalized V5 seqno and signed external hash, one internal deployment, matching Curve code/data StateInit, no extra descendants.

steps.name: deploy-guard
requiresPreviousStep: Exact finalized V5 seqno and signed external hash, one internal deployment, matching Curve code/data StateInit, no extra descendants.
acceptance: Exact finalized deployment; matching code/data, is_migration_authorized remains zero.

steps.name: deploy-migration
requiresPreviousStep: Exact finalized deployment; matching code/data, is_migration_authorized remains zero.
acceptance: Exact finalized deployment; matching code/data; no DEX deposit or graduation authorized.

steps.name: initialize-curve
requiresPreviousStep: Exact finalized deployment; matching code/data; no DEX deposit or graduation authorized.
acceptance: Admin-authenticated initialize message, authentic minter/wallet/guard/migrator identities and wallet code. Curve state1.

steps.name: mandatory-creation-donation
requiresPreviousStep: Admin-authenticated initialize message, authentic minter/wallet/guard/migrator identities and wallet code. Curve state1.
acceptance: Actual executed 0.02 TON message to the immutable recipient and comment; matching child transaction and debit. Self-payment is not an independent-payer test.

steps.name: mint-test-supply
requiresPreviousStep: Actual executed 0.02 TON message to the immutable recipient and comment; matching child transaction and debit. Self-payment is not an independent-payer test.
acceptance: Exact operator-authorized one-billion-unit mint, minter supply1e18, Curve-wallet owner/master/code and actual balance1e18. Curve state2. Expected automatic admin request exit73 is not success or renunciation.

steps.name: operator-renounce
requiresPreviousStep: Exact operator-authorized one-billion-unit mint, minter supply1e18, Curve-wallet owner/master/code and actual balance1e18. Curve state2. Expected automatic admin request exit73 is not success or renunciation.
acceptance: Actual minter change_admin(null), fixed renounce query, authentic minter callback to Curve with supply1e18 and null admin; Curve state3. Renunciation is irreversible and callback performs activation.

steps.name: small-test-buy
requiresPreviousStep: Actual minter change_admin(null), fixed renounce query, authentic minter callback to Curve with supply1e18 and null admin; Curve state3. Renunciation is irreversible and callback performs activation.
acceptance: Fresh active Curve quote for attachment minus existing0.04TON overhead. Actual sender-wallet operation ID from Curve logical time, recipient delivery and authenticated outcome2, exact reserve/fee/custody reconciliation.

steps.name: expected-slippage-rejection
requiresPreviousStep: Fresh active Curve quote for attachment minus existing0.04TON overhead. Actual sender-wallet operation ID from Curve logical time, recipient delivery and authenticated outcome2, exact reserve/fee/custody reconciliation.
acceptance: Actual Curve exit404 and routed native bounce to operator, unchanged reserve/token/fee accounts. Gas loss is expected; missing bounce is pending, not refunded.

activation.trigger: Authenticated minter renounce callback; verify Curve state3, never infer from wallet acceptance.

notes: Template fingerprints are not TON Connect request fingerprints or approvals. No expiry is generated offline.
Nominal seqnos assume no other transfers. Recovery queries consume wallet seqnos; read again before each approval.
All receipts require exact finalized trace and state review; API snapshots alone never establish delivery.
